title: Bros Attacks
subtitle: Cooperative techniques filed by Waluigi
description: A Bros Attack is a coordinated maneuver in which two allies spend timing, positioning, and trust to produce an effect neither could reliably make alone. The archive currently contains two confirmed techniques.

clearing.name: Clearing
clearing.summary: One partner creates height or leverage so the other can cut, break or force a way through.
clearing.doctrine: The lifter owns the footing, the cutter owns the arc, and neither counts out loud.
clearing.sourceNote: Named for the Feyward corridor cut, where a countdown nearly caused friendly fire and a shared rhythm succeeded.

support_fire.name: Support Fire
support_fire.summary: One partner controls the sightline and the timing; the other delivers the shot and resets.
support_fire.doctrine: The caller is responsible for the miss. The shooter is responsible for the reset.
support_fire.sourceNote: Named for the manoeuvre Green T taught Remi from a printed sheet and used against a barricaded door.

lift_carry.name: Lift and Carry
lift_carry.summary: Moving a person or a heavy object that one character cannot move alone — under fire, or under protest.
lift_carry.doctrine: Decide who is carrying before you pick anything up. Arguing mid-lift is how people get dropped.
lift_carry.sourceNote: Recorded three times: Toadsworth and Thornpaw lifting the frozen Luigi block, Markop's firefighter carry of Remi, and Lanky taking Koffin-K around the middle with Bulky piling in behind.

shieldwork.name: Shieldwork
shieldwork.summary: One partner holds a line or absorbs an attack so the other can act without being interrupted.
shieldwork.doctrine: Hold the rim, brace the wrist, and shove — a shield that only blocks is half a shield.
shieldwork.sourceNote: Named for Remi holding the cottage line during the imp ambush, shield rim biting her wrist while she shoved the invisible attacker back.

misdirection.name: Misdirection
misdirection.summary: One partner manufactures a distraction so the other can move, strike or slip past unobserved.
misdirection.doctrine: The distraction has to cost something to be believed.
misdirection.sourceNote: Named for the Platform Four bypass — combined steam distraction and a theatrical toe-injury covering a manual flux purge.

attacks.name: Support Fire Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Green T and Remi's barricaded-door technique
attacks.description: One partner steadies the shooter's aim, adjusts her position, and calls the timing so the shot lands with greater force and accuracy. Green T taught Remi the maneuver from a simple instruction sheet. Remi immediately used it against the tanuki behind a barricaded bathroom door, making the technique effective and the circumstances disastrous.
steps: Choose the shooter and the partner providing the brace or timing call.
The support partner corrects stance, sightline, and target timing.
The shooter waits for the call rather than firing on impulse.
Resolve the shot with improved coordination, then account for the moral and tactical consequences.
attacks.risks: The technique improves a bad decision as efficiently as a good one. A clearer shot does not make the target lawful, safe, or deserving of being shot.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Green T managed to turn mentorship into a firearms incident before the ink on the instructional sheet dried. That is not a failure of coordination. That is coordination working for the wrong sentence.

drill.promptDescription: Green T lines up the shot and calls the moment. Remi fires, then resets safely.

steps.title: Steady the aim
steps.instruction: Hold Space (or hold the button). Release the instant the charge meter is in the green zone.

steps.title: Call the timing
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Fire
steps.instruction: Wait for GO, then press Enter (or click) immediately. Too early or too late misses.

steps.title: Reset safely
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

attacks.name: Chop Bros
attacks.subtitle: Hjumpik and Toad Lee's twenty-five-foot corridor cut
attacks.description: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee to vine-height while Toad Lee chops through the growth ahead. The first attempt failed because Toad Lee was too heavy. The second nearly produced friendly fire after a countdown. The third worked when they stopped counting and found a shared rhythm, opening twenty-five feet of corridor and pushing the leaves back.
steps: Hjumpik establishes a stable lift and carries Toad Lee into cutting range.
Toad Lee keeps the axe clear of Hjumpik and the Guard.
Both partners move by rhythm rather than a shouted countdown.
Advance through the opened growth and stop before exhaustion turns the lift into a drop.
attacks.risks: The lift is heavy, the axe has a wide arc, and a countdown can make the swing arrive before the body is ready. The technique requires trust and room to fail safely.
attacks.result: Verified success: twenty-five feet of corridor opened; a large amount of leaf growth pushed back; the party reached the window and climbed upward at the end of the engagement.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Attempt One failed on weight. Attempt Two failed on numbers. Attempt Three succeeded when the bros stopped performing the maneuver and started listening to each other. I hate how instructive this is.

drill.promptDescription: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee. Toad Lee chops the growth. The pair advances through the opening.

steps.title: Lift Toad Lee
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↑ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down again
steps.instruction: One more — press ↓ (or click) when the marker hits the green zone.

steps.title: Advance
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

attacks.name: Gamma Discrepancy Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Markop and Green T analyze historical data to uncover a hidden truth
attacks.description: Markop and Green T examine the historical records, uncovering inconsistencies that hint at a hidden truth. Their coordination allows them to piece together fragments of information that others would miss.
steps: Highlight key dates on the timeline.
Focus the magnifying glass on suspicious entries.
Elevate a record to reveal hidden layers.
Scroll through archives for overlooked details.
attacks.risks: Misinterpreting data could lead to incorrect conclusions.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Two pairs of glasses staring at the same screen, but seeing entirely different things. Markop's optimism and Green T's skepticism make for a fascinating duo, or so they think.

drill.promptDescription: Analyze a historical event using two sources of information.

steps.title: Highlight

steps.title: Focus Lens
steps.instruction: zoom into suspicious entries with a magnifying glass

steps.title: Elevate Record
steps.instruction: scroll up to reveal hidden layers of documents

steps.title: Scroll Archives
steps.instruction: scan through archives for overlooked details

attacks.name: Detonation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: The Original Dan creates a massive fire detonation while the Feyward Dan attempts to escape harm.
attacks.description: The Original Dan, with full fire capabilities, detonates a massive fire explosion to protect himself from the Feyward Dan. The Feyward Dan tries to escape but is left wounded and broken by the blast.
steps: Dan (Original — Mages' Guild Fire Mage): Time your detonation as the Feyward Dan runs past.
Dan (Feyward / Copy): Move to the right to avoid the blast.
Dan (Original — Mages' Guild Fire Mage): Use your shield to hold off any incoming attacks or distractions.
Dan (Feyward / Copy): Attempt to escape the scene while still under fire.
attacks.risks: If the Feyward Dan does not time his dodge correctly, he will be caught in the blast. The Original Dan must ensure the timing is precise to avoid harming the Feyward Dan.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! So much for a peaceful resolution. This is why identity crises are so messy.

drill.promptDescription: Partner A creates a fire detonation while Partner B attempts to escape harm.

steps.title: Set Trap
steps.instruction: Position yourself and imagine the blast.

steps.title: Evasive Maneuver
steps.instruction: Dodge to the right as Partner A aims.

steps.title: Hold Line
steps.instruction: Imagine absorbing an attack or distraction.

steps.title: Escape
steps.instruction: Attempt to move away from the blast area.

attacks.name: Misdirection Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Mushroom Regency misdirects Toadsworth to allow Fawful to escape
attacks.description: Mushroom Regency creates a distraction to mislead Chancellor Toadsworth, allowing Fawful to escape from the scene of the assassination. This act of misdirection is crucial in shifting public and political attention away from Fawful.
steps: Mushroom Regency: Mushroom Regency draws Toadsworth's attention to a false lead.
Toadsworth the Elder: Toadsworth moves toward the distraction, giving Fawful time to slip away.
Mushroom Regency: Mushroom Regency continues the ruse to keep Toadsworth engaged.
Toadsworth the Elder: Fawful takes advantage of the momentary chaos and escapes the scene.
attacks.risks: If the distraction is too obvious, Toadsworth may catch on to the ruse, thus failing to misdirect and potentially exposing Fawful.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Regency's little 'distraction' just made Fawful look like a bigger fool than usual. How does this help anybody? Tsk tsk...

drill.promptDescription: Create a diversion to mislead a pursuer.

steps.title: Draw Attention
steps.instruction: Mimic looking at something far away.

steps.title: Escape
steps.instruction: Simulate a quick sprint.

steps.title: Maintain Cover
steps.instruction: Quickly look back to keep the pursuer focused.

steps.title: Secure Exit
steps.instruction: Simulate opening a door and walking through it.

attacks.name: Goblin Alchemy Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Markop creates height, Archie slices through the blood manor's defenses.
attacks.description: Markop uses his alchemy skills to create a height advantage, allowing Archie Miser to launch an air attack and slice through the defenses of the blood manor.
steps: Markop taps up to create a vial of Blazefizz Gloomvials.
Archie aims at the weak point in the wall with his fire magic.
Blazefizz Gloomvials ignite, giving Archie an opportunity to strike.
Archie Miser cuts through the defenses with his mage's blade.
attacks.risks: If Markop fails to create a stable height advantage, Archie could be exposed or injured during the attack.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Yet another reckless move that nearly got them all killed. Markop, you're a walking alchemy kit. Archie, you’re still alive... for now.

drill.promptDescription: Create height and leverage to allow your partner to strike an enemy weak point.

steps.title: Tap Up
steps.instruction: Use an alchemical vial to create a stable height advantage.

steps.title: Aim
steps.instruction: Target the weak point with your magical attack.

steps.title: Stabilize
steps.instruction: Maintain height and leverage until your partner's attack connects.

steps.title: Strike
steps.instruction: Execute the final blow on the weak point.

attacks.name: Teleportation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Koopa and Tanukiburt teleport to unknown coordinates connecting to the Shadow Estate
attacks.description: Koopa and Tanukiburt teleported together to unknown dimensional coordinates. This move was crucial as it allowed them to escape the dangerous situation in the Star Shard Caves and connect with another location.
steps: Focus gaze on the teleportation target.
Initiate the teleportation.
Follow through by jumping slightly to enhance the teleportation effect.
Crouch to absorb some of the impact after teleporting.
attacks.risks: If the target location is not properly scouted, the teleported characters may land in a dangerous or hostile environment.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Teleporting like that? Did you check if the other side is safe for landing? WAH!

drill.promptDescription: Prepare to teleport to an unknown location

steps.title: Focus
steps.instruction: Select your destination point

steps.title: Initiate
steps.instruction: Execute the teleportation

steps.title: Jump
steps.instruction: Enhance your jump for better landing

steps.title: Crouch
steps.instruction: Prepare to absorb impact upon arrival

attacks.name: Misdirection Bros Attack (Variant)
attacks.subtitle: Diddy distracts the mourners while Chunky escapes in a broom closet.
attacks.description: Diddy distracts the mourners with a heartfelt eulogy, while Chunky slips away unnoticed and finds himself in a broom closet at the end of the funeral. This clever move showcases Diddy's talent for creating a diversion that allows Chunky to escape detection.
steps: Diddy Kong: Gaze into the crowd and speak with emotion.
Junimus Gorolini Bongo Jr. (Chunky Kong): Sneak out of sight while Diddy is speaking.
Diddy Kong: Maintain the flow of the speech, ensuring no one suspects anything.
Junimus Gorolini Bongo Jr. (Chunky Kong): Quickly make for a hidden spot and hide.
attacks.risks: If Diddy's distraction fails, Chunky might be caught. Conversely, if he is not quick enough, the mourners will notice his absence.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! More secrets in this family. Chunky should have known better than to trust a Kong to keep a secret!

drill.promptDescription: Distract the crowd while your partner escapes unnoticed.

steps.title: Create Distraction
steps.instruction: Speak passionately into the mic.

steps.title: Exit Stage Right
steps.instruction: Sneak away without drawing attention.

steps.title: Maintain Flow
steps.instruction: Keep the speech going smoothly.

steps.title: Secure Shelter
steps.instruction: Find a hidden spot and hide quickly.

attacks.name: Jumping Coordination Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Ghost and Brick simultaneously jump from the classroom window into the void
attacks.description: Corporal 'Ghost' Reyes and Sergeant 'Brick' Stone, both injured but determined to survive the operation, simultaneously leap from the classroom window into the void. By jumping together, they misdirect Baldi's attention and give themselves a brief respite in the void.
steps: Corporal 'Ghost' Reyes: Tap when you're ready to jump.
Sergeant 'Brick' Stone: Jump simultaneously as soon as A taps.
Corporal 'Ghost' Reyes: Drop into the void after jumping.
Sergeant 'Brick' Stone: Leap down after A, aiming to land next to them in the void.
attacks.risks: If one partner jumps too early or late, they risk losing coordination and falling apart.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! You think this is clever? Jumping into the void? What kind of cover are you two providing?

drill.promptDescription: Simultaneously tap and jump to land together in the void.

steps.title: Countdown
steps.instruction: Tap when ready.

steps.title: Leap
steps.instruction: Jump at the same time as A.

steps.title: Dive
steps.instruction: Land in the void with B.

steps.title: Follow
steps.instruction: Leap down after A, aiming to land next to them.

attacks.name: Tanuki Liberation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Remi presses the gun while Green T adjusts her aim downward.
attacks.description: Remi took the initiative to use a Bros Attack technique taught by Green T, adjusting her aim downward before firing through the barricaded bathroom door. This action freed The Tanuki from the dangerous situation.
steps: Remi takes hold of the gun.
Green T taps Remi's arm slightly for aiming correction.
Remi aligns and fires the shot.
The Tanuki is released and unharmed.
attacks.risks: If the aim was not adjusted, there would be a higher risk of collateral damage.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! And this is how you get yourself in trouble. Remi, focus on your target next time!

drill.promptDescription: Align and fire to free The Tanuki.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Align the gun while partner adjusts.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.instruction: Tap A's arm to correct the aim.

steps.title: Fire
steps.instruction: Pull the trigger when aligned.

steps.title: Release
steps.instruction: Step to the side for The Tanuki's release.

attacks.name: Shieldwork Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Michael Afton holds the line so Wario can speak with Cassidy
attacks.description: Michael Afton shields Wario from the animatronics so that he can have a conversation with Cassidy, ensuring his safety and allowing for the resolution of the supernatural crisis.
steps: Michael Afton: Place yourself between Wario and the animatronics to create a barrier.
Wario / 'The Boss': Engage in dialogue with Cassidy, explaining the situation and securing the release of the animatronic spirits.
Michael Afton: Carefully move to maintain your defensive posture while Wario is speaking, ensuring continuous protection.
Wario / 'The Boss': Acknowledge Cassidy's release with a firm tap as the animatronics are set free on Night Seven.
attacks.risks: If Michael Afton's shieldwork is compromised, Wario may be overwhelmed by the animatronics before he can secure their release.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! So much blocking and talking. How do you even know what to say in there?

drill.promptDescription: Wario must have a conversation with Cassidy while being shielded from the animatronics by Michael Afton

steps.title: Set Up
steps.instruction: Place yourself between Wario and the animatronics, creating a protective barrier

steps.title: Engage
steps.instruction: Begin speaking with Cassidy to secure their release

steps.title: Adjust
steps.instruction: Continuously move and block while Wario is talking, ensuring he can communicate freely

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instruction: Acknowledge the release with a tap as the animatronics are freed on Night Seven

attacks.name: Waluigi's Distraction Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Princess Daisy and Waluigi create a diversion to allow Toadsworth Sr. to sign the Charter unseen
attacks.description: During a tense session, Waluigi and Princess Daisy stage an impromptu game of hide-and-seek with Toadsworth Sr. to draw his attention away from the Charter signing ceremony. This allows Toadsworth Sr., who is initially reluctant but ultimately wants to sign the document, to do so without interruption.
steps: Princess Daisy taps Waluigi, signaling for their distraction to begin.
Waluigi quickly moves towards Toadsworth Sr., creating a playful chase scene.
Toadsworth Sr. becomes distracted by the children's game, temporarily forgetting about signing the Charter.
Waluigi and Princess Daisy slip away, allowing Toadsworth Sr. to sign the document while unaware of their actions.
attacks.risks: If the distraction fails, it could cause a security breach or provoke an argument.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! This was my greatest moment of genius—turning a tense political situation into a childish game. The Congress owes me something for this one.

drill.promptDescription: Create a diversion to allow Toadsworth Sr. to sign the Charter unseen.

steps.title: Signal
steps.instruction: Tap Waluigi when ready for the distraction.

steps.title: Chase
steps.instruction: Lead Toadsworth Sr. towards a playful chase.

steps.title: Distract
steps.instruction: Draw Toadsworth Sr.'s attention with gestures and sounds.

steps.title: Sign
steps.instruction: Allow Toadsworth Sr. to sign the Charter while distracted.

attacks.name: Toad Rescue Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Mario and Luigi extract from Bowser's body
attacks.description: Trapped within Bowser’s body, Mario and Luigi coordinated to navigate through the labyrinthine interior. Using their combined strength and agility, they cleared a path to freedom, evading Dark Star fragments and biological threats.
steps: Mario taps up to signal direction change.
Luigi aims right to confirm alignment.
Both partners simultaneously jump down into the next chamber.
They reset their positions for another passage.
attacks.risks: If one partner misjudges the timing, they risk getting separated or trapped further within Bowser’s body.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Mario and Luigi were busy with their 'rescue' while I was out here documenting the chaos. Classic.

steps.instruction: Signal path change by tapping up

steps.title: Alignment Aim

steps.title: Jump Down

steps.instruction: Adjust positioning for next passage

attacks.name: Ghostly Misdirection Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Wario distracts while the neighbor's machinery is reconfigured for escape.
attacks.description: Wario created a diversion, chatting with the neighbor about seemingly innocent matters, while the neighbor reconfigured his security systems to allow Wario basement access. The distraction was so effective that it even fooled Waluigi.
steps: Partner A taps Partner B's shoulder to signal the start of the distraction.
Partner B begins adjusting settings on a device, creating a mechanical whirring sound.
Partner A starts a casual conversation about trivial matters.
Partner B makes subtle adjustments to a hidden camera angle.
attacks.risks: If Wario talks too much or the neighbor's attention is drawn away from the setup, the diversion might fail.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! This 'distraction' was so good that it even fooled me. Can't believe I didn't see through it!

drill.promptDescription: Partner A taps Partner B's shoulder to signal the start of a casual conversation.

steps.title: Taps
steps.instruction: Right shoulder, when you're ready.

steps.title: Adjusts
steps.instruction: Start making subtle adjustments with your device.

steps.title: Talks
steps.instruction: Gestures to the neighbor's plant, aiming for non-threatening small talk.

steps.title: Whispers
steps.instruction: Mutter something about machinery adjustments that only Partner A can hear.

attacks.name: Astral Portal Creation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Archie Miser and The Oracle perform the ritual without a circle.
attacks.description: Archie Miser absorbs dangerous amounts of mana to create a portal, while The Oracle channels energy and focuses the ritual. Together they manage to open an Astral Altar, enabling Archie to travel to the Shadowfell.
steps: Archie Miser: Tap the center of the circle.
The Oracle: Point at the candles to focus energy.
Archie Miser: Gather mana by rising your hand.
The Oracle: Channel energy to create the portal.
attacks.risks: If either partner fails their roll, the portal may collapse or malfunction, endangering all participants.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! To think, two mages of this caliber could pull off a ritual without a circle. What will they do next? Sacrifice a village?

drill.promptDescription: Simulate the creation of the Astral Portal with precise gestures.

steps.title: Center Yourself
steps.instruction: Tap the center of the circle.

steps.title: Align the Candles
steps.instruction: Point at the candles to focus energy.

steps.title: Absorb Mana
steps.instruction: Gather mana by rising your hand.

steps.title: Direct Energy
steps.instruction: Channel energy to create the portal.

attacks.name: Ruler Counterattack Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: 'Brick' Stone and 'Viper' Miller synchronize their movements to counter Baldi's ruler attack.
attacks.description: 'Brick' Stone and 'Viper' Miller coordinate their movements to create a defensive line against Baldi's ruler, which grows to four times its normal size. Stone holds the line while Miller strikes with his combat knife.
steps: Sergeant 'Brick' Stone: Brick Stone crouches and extends arms to block Baldi's ruler.
Specialist 'Viper' Miller: Viper Miller swiftly cuts at the ruler as it descends.
Sergeant 'Brick' Stone: Brick Stone shifts his weight to absorb the impact of Baldi's counterattack.
Specialist 'Viper' Miller: Viper Miller steps back, ready for the next attack while maintaining distance.
attacks.risks: If Stone's hold line is broken, the ruler will continue its growth and may cause significant damage.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! So predictable. Brick Stone and Viper Miller are just two more pawns in Baldi's grand game of mathematical precision.

drill.promptDescription: Simulate Baldi's ruler attack as it grows to four times its size.

steps.title: Counter
steps.instruction: Brick Stone raises his arms to block the ruler.

steps.title: Defend and Counter
steps.instruction: Viper Miller strikes at the descending ruler while maintaining balance.

steps.title: Absorb Impact
steps.instruction: Brick Stone shifts his weight to absorb the impact of Baldi's counterattack.

steps.title: Reset
steps.instruction: Viper Miller steps back, ready for the next attack while maintaining distance.

attacks.name: Frozen Shieldwork Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Waluigi holds an ice shield while Hjumpik moves through the frozen manor
attacks.description: Waluigi conjures a localized ice shield to hold off the advancing overgrowth, while Hjumpik navigates through the manor and moves important items aside. This allows the team to continue their operations without interruption.
steps: Waluigi: Create a localized ice shield in front of you.
Hjumpik: Navigate around the frozen area, moving objects and debris to clear a path.
Waluigi: Maintain the shield while Hjumpik passes through the cleared space.
Hjumpik: Continue clearing the path, ensuring no fresh growth blocks it.
attacks.risks: If Waluigi's ice shield falters, Hjumpik could be exposed to the overgrowth.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! This is why I'm always so careful. One slip and we're all covered in mushrooms again!

drill.promptDescription: Navigate through a frozen area while maintaining an ice shield.

steps.title: Create Shield
steps.instruction: Create an ice shield and maintain it for three seconds.

steps.title: Clear Path
steps.instruction: Move to the right, clearing a path through frozen plants.

steps.title: Hold Shield
steps.instruction: Maintain the shield while B clears past.

steps.title: Final Clear
steps.instruction: Clear any final obstacles in your path.
